[[File:FennShysa.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Fenn Shysa was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] and constable on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
'''Constable''' was a [[Police rank|rank]] and title used predominantly among [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
